title: DESIGN.md — InForm design language (Ariya Signals reskin)

display.purpose: Hero numbers/headlines (t-display-72/48), mono for the figure itself per the One Ledger rule.

mono.purpose: Every number, timestamp, and count (JetBrains Mono).

shadows.name: glass-shadow
shadows.purpose: Passive chrome only (top bar, sidebar, filter bar, menus).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover/focus micro-transitions on buttons, inputs, chips.

motion.name: duration-cap
motion.purpose: Hard ceiling per DESIGN.md — no transition in the system should exceed this.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled Signal Indigo CTA — the one color-filled-flat primitive (neumorphic-only fails contrast per DESIGN.md Accessibility).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-ui); border: 0; cursor: pointer; background: var(--indigo-500); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.25) inset, 0 6px 16px -6px rgba(42,118,244,0.55); transition: transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease, background .12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--indigo-600); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--indigo-600); transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--ring-indigo), 0 6px 16px -6px rgba(42,118,244,0.55); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neumorphic cream button for non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-ui); border: 0; cursor: pointer; background: var(--cream-100); color: var(--ink-900); box-shadow: -2px 6px 10px rgba(29,27,32,0.10), 0px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.70); transition: transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--cream-50); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: -3px 10px 18px rgba(29,27,32,0.14), 0px -3px 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.80); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 8px rgba(29,27,32,0.18), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.60); background: var(--cream-100); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default flat content container; most Ariya components (KpiCard, SignalCard) use the stronger neu-raised recipe instead of this plain variant.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--cream-100); border: 1px solid var(--cream-300); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 18px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field — neumorphic inset, indigo focus ring, no bare border-only focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--cream-50); border: 1px solid var(--cream-300); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 11px 14px; font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-ui); color: var(--ink-900); box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 6px rgba(164,167,174,0.55), inset -3px -3px 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.85); outline: none; transition: border-color .12s, box-shadow .12s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-500); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--indigo-500); box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 6px rgba(164,167,174,0.55), inset -3px -3px 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.85), var(--ring-indigo); }

components.name: Severity Tag
components.description: Severity/status label — tinted background matched to the semantic color family, never pill-shaped for severity (reserve pill for filters).
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); font: 500 12px/1 var(--font-ui); background: var(--cream-200); color: var(--ink-800); } .ds-tag-error { background: var(--crimson-050); color: var(--crimson-600); } .ds-tag-alert { background: var(--amber-050); color: #8B6D00; } .ds-tag-approved { background: var(--sage-050); color: var(--sage-600); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Selectable pill filter for feed/table filter bars.
components.css: .ds-chip-select { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: var(--indigo-050); color: var(--ink-700); font: 500 13px/1 var(--font-accent); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: all .12s; } .ds-chip-select:hover { background: var(--indigo-100); color: var(--indigo-600); } .ds-chip-select.is-active { background: var(--indigo-050); color: var(--indigo-500); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(42,118,244,0.25); } .ds-chip-count { color: var(--indigo-500); margin-left: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A monitoring workspace that feels like a precision instrument on a warm wooden desk, not a cold enterprise dashboard. Two failure modes to avoid: too cold (legacy enterprise blue-grey) and too casual (consumer-AI playful). The register is a senior analyst's tool: calm, legible, evidence-first, quietly premium. The system has exactly two material layers that never blend: frosted glass for passive chrome (top bar, nav, filter bar, menus), and opaque neumorphic cream for the workspace/content layer (cards, feed rows, KPI tiles, inputs).
keyCharacteristics: Two-layer material rule: glass only for chrome, neumorphism only for content.
Signal Indigo is the one accent, reserved for AI/citations/primary action.
Neumorphic base is always cream, never pure white — pure white collapses the shadows.
JetBrains Mono for every number, timestamp, count, and code-like token.
Motion capped at 320ms, no bounce, no tilt, no glow.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Rule
rules.body: Glass only for chrome, neumorphism only for content. A glass content card or a neumorphic top bar is a violation.

rules.name: The Cream-Not-White Rule
rules.body: Neumorphic base must be cream, never pure white — pure white collapses the shadows.

rules.name: The One Ledger Rule
rules.body: Every number, timestamp, count, and code-like token uses JetBrains Mono (.num, .mono) — a signature of the system.

rules.name: The Flat-CTA Rule
rules.body: Primary CTAs are color-filled flat (indigo), not pure neumorphic — neumorphic-only states fail WCAG AA contrast.

dos: Do use Signal Indigo (#2A76F4) as the only accent across the system.
Do set every number/timestamp in JetBrains Mono.
Do keep the neumorphic base cream, never pure white.
Do reserve glass for passive chrome only.
Do give every interactive element an explicit focus ring (--ring-indigo/--ring-ink) — shadow inversion alone isn't enough for keyboard visibility.
Do keep muted/caption text at ink-600 or darker on cream (WCAG AA floor).
donts: Don't blend glass and neumorphic materials on the same element.
Don't use rgba(5,10,68,0.35–0.40) or lighter for text — verified to fail WCAG AA.
Don't exceed 320ms on any transition, and never use bounce/spring easing.
Don't use a second accent color alongside Signal Indigo.
